text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flash! This is a once-in-a-lifetime
request! You
gotta do a concert with me!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you say that about your last
request too?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I did, but I reeeally mean it this
time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When I was watching your last concert...
You
looked so cool, but also cute at the
same time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I just know that performing with you
would take
me to a whole other level!
Soooo... please? ☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Your praise is appreciated, but my
schedule for
the next while is set, I'm
afraid...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There must be something you can do! I
want to
show your fans a whole new
world!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I can't possibly let my friend's Umadol potential go to waste! ☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. I see you've made up your mind,
so I'll
adjust my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yippee! ☆ Thanks a bunch, Flash! We'll
show your
fans the show of a lifetime!
